annotation.title_clean: Civil Liability Arising from Damages Resulting from the Use of Artificial Intelligence in the Profession of Robotic Medicine
annotation.title_en: Civil Liability Arising from Damages Resulting from the Use of Artificial Intelligence in the Profession of Robotic Medicine
named_instruments_referenced: EU Civil Law Rules on Robotics 2017
UAE Federal Medical Liability Law No. 4 of 2016
UAE Medical Liability Executive Regulations No. 40 of 2019
annotation.summary_en: Journal article on civil liability for harm caused by AI in robotic medicine, analysing UAE Federal Medical Liability Law No. 4 of 2016 and the 2017 EU civil law rules on robotics. It examines fault, damage and causation, and compensation consequences, and notes UAE healthcare AI adoption.
key_provisions_or_claims: Analyses UAE Federal Medical Liability Law No. 4 of 2016 and Executive Regulations No. 40 of 2019 for robotic medicine.
Reviews the EU Legal Affairs Committee's 2017 civil law rules on robotics.
Civil liability elements: fault, damage, and causation between physician error and patient harm.
Legal consequences include judicial and contractual compensation.
UAE health authorities have successfully implemented AI, e.g. X-ray screening and Dubai Health Authority.
